crm_brief.body:
Call brief (from the CRM record the agent confirmed and the agent's own prep notes; use it to stay relevant, never read it out, and never promise anything from it that the playbook or company facts do not support):
{{crm.brief}}

learned_instructions.body:
How this team prefers its cards (learned from the agents' ratings). Follow these when they fit, but the playbook entry, the company facts and every rule above always win; if one of these conflicts with them, ignore it:
{{learning.instructions}}

playbook_suggest.body: Came up on {{suggestion.count}} calls in the last {{suggestion.days}} days. Write the answer your team should give, then approve it to add it to the playbook.

summary.body:
Summarise this sales call for {{company.name}} in at most 6 short lines, in English:
1. What the customer wants (product, size, budget, timing).
2. Objections raised and how they were handled.
3. Questions left open (include these escalations: {{call.escalations}}).
4. Next step agreed, measured against the call goal: {{company.call_goal}}.
Never invent facts that are not in the transcript.

Transcript:
{{call.transcript}}

playbook.question: What is the payment plan?
playbook.short_answer: Ten percent on booking, fifty percent during construction, and forty percent on handover. No interest.
playbook.details: 10/50/40 plan on all Palm Grove Residences units. Construction instalments every quarter.
playbook.follow_up: Would a plan like that fit how you'd like to pay?

playbook.question: When is handover?
playbook.short_answer: Handover is planned for the fourth quarter of 2028, and construction is on schedule.
playbook.details: Q4 2028 per the developer's schedule. Do not promise a specific month.
playbook.follow_up: Is that timing right for you, or are you looking for something ready sooner?

playbook.question: How much is a one-bedroom apartment?
playbook.short_answer: One-bedroom apartments start from 1.2 million dirhams, depending on floor and view.
playbook.details: From AED 1.2M (low floors, garden view) to AED 1.6M (high floors, sea view).
playbook.follow_up: Which matters more to you, the view or the price?

playbook.question: How much is a two-bedroom apartment?
playbook.short_answer: Two-bedroom apartments start from 1.9 million dirhams, depending on floor and view.
playbook.follow_up: Is this for your family to live in, or as an investment?

playbook.question: What are the service charges?
playbook.short_answer: Service charges are about 15 dirhams per square foot per year, which covers the pool, gym, security and cleaning.
playbook.details: AED 15/sq ft estimate from the developer; final figure is set by the owners' association.
playbook.follow_up: Shall I send you the full cost sheet?

playbook.question: Can foreigners buy?
playbook.short_answer: Yes. It is a freehold area, so any nationality can own the property outright.
playbook.details: Freehold zone. Buyer needs a passport; no residency required to buy.
playbook.follow_up: Are you buying in your own name or through a company?

playbook.question: Do I get a residence visa?
playbook.short_answer: Property of two million dirhams or more can qualify you for a long-term visa. I can check your case.
playbook.details: Golden visa threshold AED 2M. Do not promise approval; government decides.
playbook.follow_up: Would the visa be important in your decision?

playbook.question: Is there parking?
playbook.short_answer: Every apartment comes with one covered parking space, and two-bedrooms and larger get two.
playbook.details: Basement parking. Extra spaces are not for sale.
playbook.follow_up: How many cars do you have?

playbook.question: Can I see the apartment?
playbook.short_answer: Yes. We have a show apartment open every day, or I can do a video walkthrough for you.
playbook.details: Show apartment open 10:00–20:00 daily. Video walkthroughs on request.
playbook.follow_up: Would tomorrow or the weekend suit you better?

playbook.question: What is the rental return?
playbook.short_answer: Similar apartments nearby rent at around six to seven percent gross a year. I can share the comparables.
playbook.details: Indicative only, from nearby completed buildings. Never guarantee a yield.
playbook.follow_up: Are you planning to rent it out or live in it?

playbook.question: It's too expensive.
playbook.short_answer: I understand. Is it the total price or the monthly payments that worry you? The plan spreads ninety percent over four years.
playbook.details: Move the conversation to the payment plan and smaller units.
playbook.follow_up: What budget did you have in mind?

playbook.question: Another company quoted us less.
playbook.short_answer: Fair point. What does their quote include? Let's compare both line by line, including service charges and handover date.
playbook.details: Ask about size, floor, view, fees and developer track record.
playbook.follow_up: Can you share their offer so we compare properly?

playbook.question: I need to think about it.
playbook.short_answer: Of course. What is the one thing you'd want to be sure about before deciding?
playbook.details: Surface the real concern; offer a viewing to make it concrete.
playbook.follow_up: Shall we book a viewing so you can decide with all the facts?

playbook.question: Just send me the details on WhatsApp.
playbook.short_answer: Happy to. So I send the right units, is this for living or investment, and which size?
playbook.details: Agree, but qualify first so the follow-up is relevant.
playbook.follow_up: Can I call you back after you've looked, say tomorrow evening?

playbook.question: I'm not interested.
playbook.short_answer: No problem. May I ask if it's the timing or the area? Then I won't call about the wrong things.
playbook.details: Respect it. One question, then close politely.
playbook.follow_up: Is it alright if I check back in a few months?

playbook.question: Off-plan is risky.
playbook.short_answer: A fair worry. Your payments go into a government-regulated escrow account, released only as construction progresses.
playbook.details: Escrow is mandatory for off-plan sales. Developer has delivered on time before (demo fact).
playbook.follow_up: Would it help to see the construction progress report?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Hi, this is Omar from Palm Grove Realty. You asked about our new apartments?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Yes, I saw your ad last week.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Great. Are you looking to live there or to invest?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Mostly invest. What's the payment plan?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Ten percent on booking, then fifty during construction and forty on handover.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Okay. Another company quoted us 20% less for something similar.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Is it too expensive for you, or is it more about the monthly payments?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Do you allow pets in the building?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Let me check that for you.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Alright. I need to think about it.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Hi. Is there a school nearby?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Good question, there are a few in the area.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Can I pay part of it in Bitcoin?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: And can I see the show apartment this weekend?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Off-plan feels risky to me, honestly.
